text: Engaging Scarborough Councillors and Businesses in Economic Development Initiatives

Scarborough Community Council; 1. Requested the General Manager of Economic Development to report back and present at the May 18, 2021 meeting of Scarborough Community Council regarding how Economic Development staff are engaging Scarborough Community Councillors and businesses in economic development initiatives. 2. Requested the General Manager of Economic Development to report back and present at the May 18, 2021 meeting of Scarborough Community Council regarding how 2020 Economic Development programs were implemented in Scarborough, assisted Scarborough businesses, and how successful they were relative to other areas of the City, including, but not limited to: CafeTO, CurbTO, DriveInTO, ShowLoveTO, StrollTO, BigArtTO, MakeArtTO, City Hall Spotlight. 3.
